basic_info.description:
9 Pomona St, San Francisco, CA 94124 is a single family home that contains 1,258 sq ft and was built in 1925. It contains 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom. This home last sold for $1,000,000 in October 2025. 
 
The Zestimate for this house is $853,900. The Rent Zestimate for this home is $3,718/mo.
